summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）扩散模型应用年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Imagic in the Diffusion Model Application area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Imagic: Text-Based Real Image Editing with Diffusion Models”. The page names Bahjat Kawar, Shiran Zada, Michal Irani as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
